title: Jakarta railways and Bandung services distinguish operating results from expansion
summary: The North–South MRT, Whoosh and Bandung accounts retain construction scopes, operating periods, interchange needs and water/waste service boundaries. Eligibility reaches 98 projects and 68 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Seventeen official sources inspected November 22: fifteen HTML bodies or scoped segments, one indexed operator page after a JavaScript shell and one BPS catalog excerpt whose underlying release denied access. Sixteen Indonesian sources and one English source retain publication, reporting, event and future-plan dates. No additional component identities or outcome-series admission.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
